text:
whereami
Description
The whereami command returns the datacenter name for the local GTM.
Syntax
whereami
Examples
when
DNS_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
whereami
]
eq
"DC1"
}
{
pool
pool1
member
10.10
.10.10
log
local0.
"Sticking [whereami] picks to pool1 member 10.10.10.10"
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
GLOBAL_GTM
